# DANZUS Holdings LLC

DANZUS Holdings LLC is in Folsom, California. Dan Johnson builds websites and
sets up local search and missed-call text-back for small businesses in
Sacramento, Folsom, Roseville, El Dorado Hills, and nearby. Missed-call
text-back is $99 a month after a free 30-day pilot, with no setup fee, month
to month. That is the founding client price. A website is $1,500 one time,
plus $49 a month for hosting and small edits. Google and AI search is $199 a
month. DANZUS Growth is $299 a month.

Contact: call or text (916) 404-6129, or email dan@danzus.co.
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/danjohnsondata
Website: https://danzus.co

## What the assistant does

- Missed-call text-back within 60 seconds.
- Replies to website and Facebook leads.
- Quote follow-up.
- Booking and reminders.
- Google review requests after a finished job.
- Sort your email, invoice nudges, and a weekly summary.
- Answers to hours, service area, and which jobs the shop takes.

Most of it is ready to go, and the rest is written for your shop. It connects
to the calendar, QuickBooks, your customer list, or the texts the shop
already uses. The owner reads the replies. A person signs off on anything risky
before it reaches a customer. Each month DANZUS reads what went out and fixes
what sounds off. Missed-call text-back has no setup fee.

## Website

A custom site for one local business. It is fast on a phone and built so the
next step is a call or a lead: the services, the towns covered, tap to call,
and a way to send a lead. $1,500 one time, plus $49 a month for hosting and
small edits. Paid 50% up front and 50% at launch. The client keeps the site.

## Google and AI search

Your Google listing, the towns you serve, and pages Google and ChatGPT can read.
$199 a month.

## DANZUS Growth

Missed-call text-back, Google and AI search, and hosting, together. $299 a
month. With a 6-month commitment, the website is $750 instead of $1,500. Hosting
and small edits stay on the monthly plan.

## Packages

These describe the work. They are not a separate price list. The prices are
the menu above.

### Lead to Booked Job

A new inquiry becomes a time on the calendar: capture the lead, instant reply,
ask the right questions, book, and remind.

### Estimate to payment

An estimate becomes money in the account: draft the estimate, follow up, send
the invoice, and chase the payment.

### Job Closeout

A finished job leaves a review and a referral: completion photos, a review
request, and a referral ask.

### Back Office

The inbox, the bills, and the week land in one place: sort your email,
enter bills into your bookkeeping, and a weekly summary for the owner.

### Customer Service

The customer gets an answer, a status, or a person: FAQ answers, job or order
status, and a handoff.

## Questions

- What does it cost? Missed-call text-back is $99 a month after a free 30-day pilot, with no setup fee, month to month. That is the founding client price. A website is $1,500 one time, plus $49 a month for hosting and small edits, paid 50% up front and 50% at launch. The client keeps the site. Google and AI search is $199 a month. DANZUS Growth is $299 a month for text-back, Google and AI search, and hosting. With a 6-month commitment, the website is $750.
- How long does setup take? The free call picks the first job. Most of it is ready to go, and the rest is written for your shop. Then it is connected to tools the shop already uses. Missed-call text-back has no setup fee.
- Do I need new software? No.
- Is it secure? A person signs off on anything risky before it goes out. Mobile phone numbers and SMS opt-in data and consent are not shared with any third parties or affiliates. https://danzus.co/privacy
- What if the AI says something wrong? Risky messages wait for a person. Each month DANZUS reads what was sent and fixes what sounds off. An upset customer gets the owner.
- Do you work in person? Dan is in Folsom. The free call is by phone. The service area is Sacramento, Folsom, Roseville, El Dorado Hills, and nearby.

## SMS

DANZUS Text Messaging Program. When you call or text (916) 404-6129, or enter
your number on the contact form and check the SMS consent box, you agree to
receive text messages from DANZUS Holdings LLC. Messages cover missed-call
replies, answers to your inquiry, appointment scheduling and reminders, and
customer care. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.
Reply STOP to opt out at any time. Reply HELP for help, or contact
dan@danzus.co or (916) 404-6129. Consent is not a condition of purchase.
Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Privacy:
https://danzus.co/privacy Terms: https://danzus.co/terms
